text.arabic_uthmani: أَلَآ إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ قَدْ يَعْلَمُ مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَيَوْمَ يُرْجَعُونَ إِلَيْهِ فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۢ

words.gloss_range: opening attention and discourse-launch particle
words.prose: {{ar:أَلَا}} ({{tr:alā}}) makes the final ayah begin as a summons, not as quiet continuation. Its attention force joins the following confirmation particle, so the ownership claim is heard as an alerted axiom, a pairing also used for cosmic ownership claims at 10:55 and 22:64. Because it is indeclinable, it does not join the case structure of the clause; it frames the declaration before the grammar of possession unfolds. The broad open sound also gives the closure an audible launch.

topics.headline: alerted opening of the final declaration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the surah's final ayah starts by demanding attention before stating divine ownership.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as an attention particle, and the opening clause confirms that it scopes over the ownership declaration.

topics.headline: attention plus confirmation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the doubled force of attention plus confirmation, with parallels to cosmic ownership declarations (10:55; 22:64).
topics.reason: The immediately following confirming particle supports the stacked-assertion claim; cross-reference value is formulaic, not controlling.

topics.headline: fixed particle with audible opening breadth
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word is a fixed frame rather than a case participant, and that its broad vowels make the declaration open audibly.
topics.reason: The fixed particle analysis supports both the syntactic nonparticipation and the sound-shape observation.

words.gloss_range: confirming annulment particle governing a delayed subject after a fronted predicate
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) turns the opening into confirmed news and restructures the clause around possession. The possessor phrase comes before the open relative subject, so ownership is heard before the inventory of what is owned. The particle therefore does more than intensify; it gives the final axiom a grammar in which divine possession is the entry point.

topics.headline: confirmed clause with ownership first
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause does not begin from the cosmos and infer an owner; grammar puts the owner-side first.
topics.reason: The delayed relative subject and fronted prepositional predicate are syntactically licensed by the local clause.

topics.headline: assertion rather than request
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closure is delivered as settled news, not as a command or an argument still being proved.
topics.reason: The particle's confirming force matches the final declarative ownership clause.

words.gloss_range: possessive preposition in the fronted predicate
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) is the small grammatical hinge that makes the cosmic domain belong to God. Locally it is possessive and governs the divine name in genitive, while its wider purposive range can add orientation without replacing ownership. Because the phrase is fronted, the ayah moves from jurisdiction to inventory rather than from inventory to jurisdiction.

topics.headline: possessive hinge placed first
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a bound preposition makes possession the first grammatical claim of the ayah's final movement.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence licenses genitive government of the divine name and fronted-predicate function.

topics.headline: purpose pressure kept under possession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belonging can also feel oriented toward God, while local syntax keeps possession as the selected force.
topics.reason: The broader lām range is semantically relevant, but the local fronted ownership clause narrows it to possession with secondary purposive pressure.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name in genitive as the possessor in the opening clause
words.root_gloss_range: proper-name field associated with worship, refuge, and bewildered turning; locally used as the named possessor

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: possessive preposition governing the divine name

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:allāhi}}) names the possessor in genitive, so the cosmic domain is not assigned to a generic deity or abstract sacred force. The proper name carries worship, refuge, and bewildered turning as a root-field pressure, while the local case keeps its role precise: governed possessor after {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}). Its repetition later as nominative subject makes the ayah's frame move from possession to omniscience, with same-surah echoes such as the knowledge formula at 24:35, the cosmic praise scene at 24:41, and the dominion scene at 24:42. The final ayah also widens the warning of 24:63 and closes the revealed-sign opening of 24:1 with final deed-reporting.

topics.headline: proper name as governed possessor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the possessor is the proper divine name in a governed case position, not a generic theological category.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence place the proper name as genitive complement of the possessive preposition.

topics.headline: worship and bewilderment around the proper name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the owner named here is also the one toward whom worship, refuge, and overwhelmed turning gather, while the local grammar remains proper-name possession.
topics.reason: The derivational field is meaningful as pressure but cannot replace the proper-name function in the clause.

topics.headline: same named referent frames ownership and omniscience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening possessor and closing knower are the same named referent, so return and disclosure sit inside one divine frame.
topics.reason: The ayah repeats the divine name at the opening and closing, and the same formula appears in the Light Verse (24:35).

topics.headline: local closure gathers prior divine-cosmic scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this possession phrase gathers prior divine-cosmic language in Surah 24, including light, praise, and dominion scenes (24:35; 24:41; 24:42).
topics.reason: The supplied cross-reference and collocation rows support echo value without making those scenes govern the local parse.

topics.headline: from prior warning to cosmic possession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final ayah widens earlier warning into cosmic ownership and final reporting, with 24:63 and 24:1 both drawn into the closure.
topics.reason: The boundary rows point to explicit references (24:63; 24:1), and the local ayah supplies the possession, pronoun, and closing-name pattern.

topics.headline: possessor before cosmic inventory
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the expansive cosmic phrase unfolds only after the named possessor, and that the same omniscience formula returns from 24:35 at the close.
topics.reason: The local word order supports possessor-before-inventory, and the same-surah formula row identifies the 24:35 echo.

words.gloss_range: open relative pronoun as delayed subject of the confirmed ownership clause
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) is delayed after the fronted possessor phrase, so what is owned arrives under ownership rather than before it. Its open relative force leaves the referent maximally inclusive: whatever is in the heavens and earth. It also begins a threefold relative-pronoun chain that moves from cosmic contents to present human state to completed deeds.

topics.headline: delayed subject with unrestricted reference
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the owned totality is grammatically delayed and left open enough to include every class of creature or thing in the cosmic span.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence places the pronoun as the delayed noun of the confirming particle and head of the relative content.

topics.headline: indeclinable form keeps scope open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word receives its syntactic role without narrowing the referent by visible gender, number, or case.
topics.reason: The fixed particle/pronoun form supports open reference while the surrounding syntax supplies the role.

topics.headline: first relative pronoun in ontology-state-action chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a repeated architecture: what exists, what the addressees are upon, and what they did are each gathered by a relative pronoun.
topics.reason: The ayah contains three relative-pronoun clauses with distinct scopes.

words.gloss_range: spatial-domain preposition governing the heavens and, by coordination, the earth
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) makes the ownership claim about what is contained within the cosmic domains. Its spatial force remains primary because the governed nouns are heavens and earth, but that spatial containment naturally widens into domain containment. A single preposition carries both sides of the cosmic pair, binding upper and lower realms into one owned span.

topics.headline: heavens and earth as contained domains
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ownership covers what is inside the domains, not merely the named domains as labels.
topics.reason: The local prepositional attachment governs the heavens and extends through coordination to the earth.

topics.headline: domain force narrowed by spatial complements
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the physical-in and domain-within senses together, while the heavens-earth complement blocks temporal or merely topical readings.
topics.reason: The preposition has wider range, but the local complements select spatial-domain containment.

topics.headline: one preposition spans the pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one governing particle unifies the upper and lower poles instead of making two separate domains.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence shows one preposition governing the first noun with the second joined into the same phrase.

words.gloss_range: definite plural heavens as the upper pole of the cosmic possession phrase
words.root_gloss_range: height, elevation, sky, overhead source, and naming associations; locally the elevated upper domains
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-samāwāti}}) supplies the upper, elevated pole of the owned domain. Its definite plural form presents the heavens as known, countable domains, while the root-field of height, canopy, and overhead source keeps their vertical force vivid. Paired with the singular earth, the word forms a cosmic merism familiar across the Qur'an and specifically resonant with Surah 24 scenes such as 24:35, 24:41, and 24:42. Its height sounds also lean toward the later knowledge and upon-language rather than remaining only visual imagery.

topics.headline: known plural heavens under possession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the upper realm is not a vague sky but a definite plural set of domains balanced against the singular earth.
topics.reason: QAC marks a definite genitive plural concrete noun governed by the preposition.

topics.headline: height, canopy, and naming pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the possessed upper domains retain height and overhead-source imagery, while local syntax keeps them as the heavens rather than abstract elevation or naming.
topics.reason: The root and lexical-sense evidence support height imagery, but the local lexical unit is the definite plural heavens.

topics.headline: first pole of the heavens-earth merism
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the heavens begin a conventional totalizing pair, so the phrase claims the whole cosmic span.
topics.reason: The local coordination and the supplied collocation profile support the merism.

topics.headline: Surah 24 reprises and height-sound echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word carries Surah 24's cosmic-light thread (24:35; 24:42) and that its height sounds lean toward the later knowledge and upon-language.
topics.reason: The cross-reference and sound rows add local texture without altering the governed noun's parse.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction binding earth to the same governed cosmic phrase
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates the earth under the same prepositional governance already placed over the heavens. The particle is not an oath or circumstantial marker here; it completes the vertical pair. Its effect is not to flatten the two poles, but to bind upper and lower domains into one total possession claim.

topics.headline: earth joined under the same governance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the earth inherits the same ownership span rather than starting a new phrase.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the earth as conjoined to the heavens under the prepositional phrase.

topics.headline: coordination rather than oath or circumstance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the vertical polarity of heavens and earth, while the local conjunction keeps the function as coordination.
topics.reason: The supplied alternatives are useful by contrast, but QAC and attachment evidence select coordination.

words.gloss_range: definite singular earth as the lower pole of the cosmic possession phrase
words.root_gloss_range: ground, broad surface, and presentation/offering associations; locally the definite earth
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) completes the cosmic merism as the lower, grounded pole. It inherits genitive case through coordination, and its singular definiteness balances the plural heavens. The root-field of ground, breadth, and presentation makes the earth feel like the broad stage under ownership, just before the ayah pivots from cosmic possession to divine knowledge. The lower pole also resumes the Light Verse's cosmic language (24:35) inside the final closure.

topics.headline: earth inherits the governed genitive role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the singular definite earth is grammatically folded into the same owned domain as the plural heavens.
topics.reason: The word is genitive by coordination and definite singular in contrast with the plural heavens.

topics.headline: ground, breadth, and presentation imagery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the earth as broad lower ground and presentation-stage, while local syntax keeps it as the definite earth in the merism.
topics.reason: The root imagery enriches the lower pole but does not replace the noun's concrete local sense.

topics.headline: merism closes before knowledge begins
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the earth completes the total cosmic pair exactly before the verse pivots into confirmed knowledge.
topics.reason: The word ends the first clause's cosmic phrase immediately before the certainty particle starts the knowledge clause.

topics.headline: earth returns from cosmic-light language
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing ownership phrase resumes Surah 24's cosmic language from the Light Verse (24:35).
topics.reason: The supplied same-surah echo has a concrete reference and remains a contextual payoff.

words.gloss_range: certainty particle scoping over the following imperfect knowledge verb

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: confirmed knowing formula formed by the certainty particle and imperfect verb

words.prose: {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) pivots from the ownership premise to a confirmed present knowledge claim. With the imperfect verb, its local force is taḥqīq: God already and certainly knows what the addressees are upon. The particle also carries forward the repeated {{ar:قَدْ يَعْلَمُ}} ({{tr:qad yaʿlamu}}) pattern from 24:63, widening the earlier warning about slipping away into direct communal exposure. Its pivot from ownership to disclosure also recalls the earlier disclosure horizon at 24:25.

topics.headline: certainty over the imperfect verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle confirms present divine knowledge locally, while possible lesser-probability force is subordinated here.
topics.reason: QAC marks a certainty particle with an imperfect verb; local divine-knowledge context favors confirmation over diminution.

topics.headline: repeated knowledge formula from 24:63
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 24:64 repeats the knowledge formula from 24:63 and expands it from hidden evasion into the whole addressee-state.
topics.reason: The row set gives the concrete 24:63 boundary, and the local phrase repeats the same particle-verb shape.

topics.headline: pivot from cosmic possession to knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah moves from God's ownership of the cosmic field to God's knowledge of the human condition, with 24:25 as a prior disclosure horizon.
topics.reason: The particle begins the knowledge clause immediately after the ownership clause and is explicitly linked by the source row to 24:25.

words.gloss_range: Form I imperfect active: he knows, with ongoing present assertion
words.root_gloss_range: knowledge, knowing the true nature of things, and world/known-order associations; locally divine cognition
words.prose: {{ar:يَعْلَمُ}} ({{tr:yaʿlamu}}) states divine knowing as an independent active assertion before any future disclosure is mentioned. The imperfect form makes the knowledge ongoing, not newly acquired at the return. Its root later resolves in {{ar:عَلِيمٌ}} ({{tr:ʿalīmun}}), so the ayah moves from God knows what you are upon to God is all-knowing. The phrase belongs to a wider knowledge register with parallels at 11:5 and 57:4, while 24:63 supplies the immediate boundary that widens into direct address here.

topics.headline: ongoing active knowledge before disclosure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine knowledge is already active and asserted before the final return scene unfolds.
topics.reason: QAC marks an imperfect active indicative verb in the knowledge clause.

topics.headline: knowing precedes reporting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse selects direct knowing here, not causative informing; disclosure comes later as a separate act.
topics.reason: The local form is Form I knowing, while the later reporting verb carries the informing function.

topics.headline: true-nature knowledge under local cognition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that knowing is not mere awareness of surfaces, while local grammar keeps the selected sense as divine cognition.
topics.reason: The broader root field is relevant as semantic pressure but must be narrowed to the local verb of knowing.

topics.headline: knowledge refrain widens into direct address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the knowledge formula joins wider Quranic and same-surah knowledge language, including 11:5, 57:4, and the immediate boundary at 24:63.
topics.reason: The source rows provide concrete comparison points, while the local clause remains the governing evidence.

words.gloss_range: open relative pronoun as object of the knowledge verb
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) opens the object of God's knowledge without naming the condition directly. After the first {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) gathered cosmic contents, this second one narrows the field to what the addressees are presently upon. Its fixed form hides visible object marking, but the syntax makes it the thing known.

topics.headline: unspecified object of divine knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the present state is exposed without being reduced to one named behavior.
topics.reason: The relative clause is the object of the knowledge verb and leaves the state lexically open.

topics.headline: indeclinable pronoun with supplied object role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that syntax, not visible case ending, marks the pronoun as what God knows.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a relative pronoun, and the attachment relation supplies object function.

topics.headline: from cosmic contents to present condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated-pronoun progression: cosmic totality narrows to the addressees' present condition.
topics.reason: The second relative pronoun is structurally parallel to the first but has a human-state scope.

words.gloss_range: independent second-person plural pronoun in the state clause
words.prose: {{ar:أَنتُمْ}} ({{tr:antum}}) pulls the discourse into direct second-person address inside an ayah otherwise framed by divine ownership and third-person return. Because the pronoun stands independently, the addressees are not merely implied by a suffix; they are placed visibly inside what God knows. The boundary with 24:63 makes the shift sharper: the warned group becomes the addressed you.

topics.headline: standalone you in the known state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the addressees are made grammatically visible rather than hidden inside verbal agreement.
topics.reason: QAC marks an independent second-person plural pronoun functioning in the nominal state clause.

topics.headline: direct address amid third-person frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the address shift from a warned third-person group in 24:63 into a direct you inside the final exposure.
topics.reason: The local person marking and supplied boundary row support a discourse shift from 24:63 into 24:64.

words.gloss_range: preposition upon plus third-person suffix marking the state the addressees occupy
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْهِ}} ({{tr:ʿalayhi}}) leaves the state referent pointed to rather than fully named. The preposition's upon-force turns the condition into something occupied, borne, or stood upon, giving moral pressure to what God knows. The suffix keeps the pointer compact and slightly open, so the present state remains connected to the preceding command and warning field without being reduced to one explicit noun.

topics.headline: unspecified suffix points to the known state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the state is left demonstratively open, making the exposure broader than a single named act.
topics.reason: The phrase is a preposition plus suffix inside the relative object clause, and no explicit local antecedent narrows it to one noun.

topics.headline: upon-force makes condition morally weighty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the addressees' condition is something they are upon or bearing, while local grammar keeps the phrase as a state complement.
topics.reason: The preposition's broader moral and spatial range survives as pressure, narrowed by the local state-clause function.

topics.headline: state clause replaces action clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that God knows not only what they do but the condition they are upon before the later deed-disclosure.
topics.reason: The clause is nominal-state language here, with completed actions appearing only later.

words.gloss_range: conjunction opening the temporal return clause after present knowledge
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) bridges the present knowledge claim into the future return scene. It can be felt as coordination and as a resumptive opening, but both readings serve the same movement: what God knows now is carried forward to the day when they are returned and informed. The particle marks a temporal boundary without severing the logic of accountability.

topics.headline: present knowledge bridged to future return
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that present exposure and future return are linked rather than treated as unrelated scenes.
topics.reason: The conjunction opens the temporal clause following the knowledge clause.

topics.headline: coordination and resumption both useful
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a boundary marker that both connects and restarts the discourse, while local syntax keeps it tied to the temporal clause.
topics.reason: The local evidence supports a temporal opening; coordination/resumption nuance is retained without overselecting one beyond the bundle.

words.gloss_range: accusative temporal noun marking the decisive day of return
words.root_gloss_range: day, appointed time, and decisive event-time; locally an eschatological temporal point
words.prose: {{ar:يَوْمَ}} ({{tr:yawma}}) turns the discourse from present knowledge to an appointed encounter-time. Grammatically it is accusative temporal framing, with some object-like pressure in the tradition, but locally it functions as the bounded day when return and disclosure occur. It gathers earlier legal and witness-day textures in Surah 24 into a final reckoning horizon and aligns with return-to-God scenes such as 2:281, 6:60, and 23:115.

topics.headline: bounded temporal point with object-like pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the return scene as a bounded appointed time, while the local clause favors temporal framing over making the day the direct object.
topics.reason: QAC marks an accusative temporal noun; alternate object pressure is retained only as a narrowed grammatical possibility.

topics.headline: decisive reckoning time
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word names not an ordinary day but the decisive event-time of return.
topics.reason: The lexical evidence and local eschatological clause support decisive event-day force.

topics.headline: day of return in accountability formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the temporal pivot belongs to a broader return-accountability field, with concrete parallels at 2:281, 6:60, and 23:115.
topics.reason: The supplied inter-ayah rows identify the formulaic parallels and same-surah gathering function.

words.gloss_range: Form I imperfect passive: they are returned
words.root_gloss_range: return, reversion, recurrence, rain-return, and repeated speech; locally passive return to God
words.prose: {{ar:يُرْجَعُونَ}} ({{tr:yurjaʿūna}}) makes return something undergone. The passive voice suppresses human agency in the return even though the next deed verb will make them agents of what they did. The root's return and recurrence field lets the scene feel like reversion to source, while the local Form I passive blocks a stronger repeated-return or causative reading. Accepted active-reading contrast can illuminate agency, but the canonical local surface presents them as returned.

topics.headline: return undergone rather than self-directed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final return is not narrated as their own initiative; they are grammatically acted upon.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a Form I imperfect passive; active variant evidence is useful for contrast but does not govern the local parse.

topics.headline: reversion to source with recurrence color
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices return as reversion to source, with recurrence imagery nearby, while local grammar keeps a single passive eschatological return.
topics.reason: Root branches add image pressure but are narrowed by the local passive return verb.

topics.headline: Form I passive in return-to-God formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a familiar return-to-God formula, with parallels such as 2:28, 36:83, and 43:85, while the local form avoids stronger derived-form nuance.
topics.reason: The local form is Form I passive, and the supplied formula rows give concrete parallels without changing the form.

topics.headline: passive return contrasts with active deed-making
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the contrast between being returned and later having actively done deeds, reinforced by the compressed sound of the passive verb.
topics.reason: The ayah later uses an active plural deed verb, making the voice contrast locally available.

words.gloss_range: directional preposition plus divine-reference suffix marking the endpoint of return
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَيْهِ}} ({{tr:ilayhi}}) gives the passive return its endpoint: to Him. The suffix ties the destination back to the same divine referent named in the opening possession phrase. The movement is therefore not only from life to an event-day, but from what belongs to God back to God.

topics.headline: God as endpoint of return
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that return is directional and terminates at the divine referent, not at an anonymous judgment event.
topics.reason: The preposition plus suffix functions as the directional complement of the passive return verb.

topics.headline: from belonging to God to returning to Him
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening ownership phrase and this return phrase form an arc: what is God's is returned to Him.
topics.reason: The same divine referent is named in the opening and resumed by suffix in the return clause.

words.gloss_range: sequential-consequential conjunction linking return to disclosure
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the informing follow as the consequence of return. The particle is tighter than simple coordination: after they are returned to Him, then He informs them. It turns the temporal scene into an accountability sequence, carrying the warning logic into final disclosure.

topics.headline: return leads immediately to disclosure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that being returned is not an endpoint by itself; it triggers the informing that follows.
topics.reason: The conjunction sits between passive return and active informing, licensing sequence and consequence.

topics.headline: tighter than simple coordination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah escalates from return into disclosure through a causal particle, not a loose connector.
topics.reason: The source rows specifically contrast the particle with looser coordination, and the local sequence supports that contrast.

words.gloss_range: Form II imperfect active: He informs them, with object suffix
words.root_gloss_range: news, consequential report, and disputed elevation/prophetic association; locally detailed divine disclosure
words.prose: {{ar:يُنَبِّئُهُمْ}} ({{tr:yunabbiʾuhum}}) makes the post-return act a detailed disclosure to them. Form II intensifies the informing beyond a bare announcement, and the attached suffix makes the recipients inseparable from the verb. The root's news field is primary here, with elevation and prophetic associations kept as secondary pressure. In formulaic terms, the verb belongs to a disclosure pattern found at 5:105, 6:60, and 62:8.

topics.headline: intensive informing after return
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final report is not casual mention but intensified disclosure of what was done.
topics.reason: QAC marks a Form II imperfect active verb, and the temporal clause makes it the disclosure act after return.

topics.headline: them bound to the disclosure verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same warned group is carried into disclosure as the direct recipients of the report.
topics.reason: The object suffix supplies the recipient group and links the return scene to the disclosure act.

topics.headline: consequential news with elevation pressure nearby
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices disclosure as consequential news, while derivational links to elevation or prophethood remain secondary rather than the local sense.
topics.reason: The root dispute survives as pressure, but the local Form II verb selects informing/reporting.

topics.headline: formulaic deed-disclosure with audible pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb participates in a recurring deed-disclosure formula (5:105; 6:60; 62:8), with the geminated sound reinforcing the pressure of detailed accounting.
topics.reason: The row set supplies concrete formula parallels and a form-specific sound observation.

words.gloss_range: preposition introducing the content by which they are informed
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) prevents the informing verb from remaining abstract: it attaches the disclosure to its content, what they did. The preposition is primarily content-governing here, though instrument-like pressure remains because the deeds themselves become the material through which the report is made. Its bound form fuses directly to the following relative pronoun.

topics.headline: content governed after informing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine informing is immediately filled with content rather than left as an abstract act.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the following relative pronoun as the content complement of the informing verb.

topics.headline: content with instrument-like pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the deeds are not just a topic but the very material by which the disclosure is made, while local grammar keeps content-governance primary.
topics.reason: The wider range of the preposition survives as nuance, but the relative complement after informing selects content.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun governed by the disclosure preposition and heading the deed clause
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) heads the final relative clause: what they did. It is governed by the attached preposition but remains fixed in form, letting the deed-content stay open and comprehensive. As the third {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) in the ayah, it completes the movement from whatever exists, to what you are upon, to what they did.

topics.headline: relative pronoun heads the deed record
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the report covers the open totality of their deeds, not a named subset.
topics.reason: The pronoun is governed by the preposition and heads the relative deed clause.

topics.headline: third relative pronoun completes the cascade
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final step of the repeated relative-pronoun architecture: existence, state, and action.
topics.reason: The ayah contains three relative-pronoun clauses whose scopes differ in a clear sequence.

words.gloss_range: Form I perfect active plural: they did/worked
words.root_gloss_range: purposeful work, deed-production, practiced action; locally completed deeds

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: prepositional relative deed formula: by or about what they did

words.prose: {{ar:عَمِلُوا}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}) turns the disclosure content into completed deeds. The perfect active plural marks them as agents of what they did, sharply contrasting with their passive return. The root favors purposeful worked action over accidental occurrence, and the formula {{ar:بِمَا عَمِلُوا}} ({{tr:bi-mā ʿamilū}}) makes deeds the stable currency of accountability, echoing earlier reward and succession contexts in Surah 24. Its rounded plural ending also binds the informed group audibly to the actions being disclosed.

topics.headline: perfect verb seals a completed record
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the report concerns deeds already completed as a record, not vague future behavior.
topics.reason: QAC marks a perfect active plural verb in the relative deed clause.

topics.headline: purposeful work rather than accidental event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices deeds as purposeful worked outputs, while the local verb remains the ordinary Form I deed verb.
topics.reason: The root evidence supports intentional-work pressure, narrowed to the local completed action.

topics.headline: active deed-makers after passive return
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same group is passive in being returned but active in producing the deeds disclosed.
topics.reason: The local verb is Form I active plural, contrasted with the earlier passive return verb.

topics.headline: formulaic deed accounting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that deed-reporting is formulaic accountability, with the final sound binding the informed group to the actions disclosed.
topics.reason: The formula rows identify the frequent deed-accounting pattern and its local cadence with the informing verb.

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction opening the independent closing nominal clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the closing coda rather than merely adding another event to the return sequence. As a resumptive transition, it lets the ayah restart at a standing axiom: God is knowing of every thing. In the ayah's three major conjunctions, this one shifts from event and consequence to attribute.

topics.headline: fresh nominal axiom
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final clause is an independent knowledge maxim, not merely the next item in the return narrative.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the final clause as a nominal coda, and QAC notes the conjunction's resumptive force.

topics.headline: third conjunction shifts into attribute
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's conjunction sequence: cosmic pair, temporal bridge, then axiomatic closure.
topics.reason: The local clause sequence supports the boundary pattern assigned to the three conjunctions.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name in nominative as subject of the closing nominal sentence
words.root_gloss_range: proper-name field associated with worship, refuge, and bewildered turning; locally the subject of the omniscience predicate
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) returns the divine name as nominative subject of the closing nominal sentence. The case shift from genitive possessor near the opening to nominative subject at the end makes the same named referent move from owner to explicit knower. The worship-and-refuge field of the name is reactivated at closure while the grammar keeps it as the subject. The name anchors the final attribute so omniscience is not an abstraction, and it also redirects the similar attribute sound from punishment in 24:63 toward divine knowledge in 24:64.

topics.headline: divine name as coda subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final attribute is attached directly to the named divine subject.
topics.reason: QAC marks nominative proper noun, and the final nominal clause makes it the subject of the predicate.

topics.headline: worship-refuge field at closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing knower is the same worship-and-refuge name, while the local grammar keeps subject function primary.
topics.reason: The root field remains a semantic pressure around the proper name but does not alter the nominative subject role.

topics.headline: genitive possessor becomes nominative knower
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's named-divine arc: genitive possessor at the opening, nominative subject at the close.
topics.reason: The same divine name appears with different case roles at word 4 and word 25.

topics.headline: explicit name launches the maxim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final maxim uses the explicit name, and that the sound-near attribute from 24:63 is now anchored in divine cognition.
topics.reason: The final clause repeats the name instead of relying on the previous suffix, and the boundary row supplies 24:63 as the contrast.

words.gloss_range: preposition attaching the universal scope phrase to the knowledge predicate
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) makes the final omniscience claim take a governed scope: every thing is the domain in which God is knowing. It is not instrumental here, as though knowledge used a tool; it marks respect and domain. Because the scope phrase comes before the final adjective, the listener hears the universality before the attribute lands.

topics.headline: scope phrase attached to omniscience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition grammatically attaches total scope to the knowledge predicate.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the totality phrase and attaches it to the final predicate.

topics.headline: universality heard before final predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the order: the scope of knowledge is placed before the closing attribute resolves the ayah.
topics.reason: The prepositional scope phrase precedes the predicate in the final nominal clause.

words.gloss_range: construct quantifier: every, each, all, governing an indefinite singular complement
words.root_gloss_range: totality and exhaustion/weariness associations; locally distributive universal quantification

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: preposition governing the universal scope phrase
indefinite singular complement of the universal quantifier

words.prose: {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}) makes the final scope distributive: every individual thing, not a vague mass of all things together. It is genitive under {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) and at the same time governs {{ar:شَىْءٍ}} ({{tr:shayʾin}}), sitting inside a two-way dependency. The root's exhaustion edge helps the totality feel exhaustive, but local construct grammar is what makes the universal scope precise.

topics.headline: every individual thing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the quantifier counts exhaustively item by item rather than as an undifferentiated collective.
topics.reason: The word is a construct head governing an indefinite singular complement.

topics.headline: governed by preposition and governing complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the quantifier is both under the preposition and binding the following noun, making the scope phrase tightly built.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence support genitive government by the preposition plus construct relation to the following noun.

topics.headline: totality with exhaustion pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an exhaustion edge to total coverage, while local grammar keeps the active meaning as universal quantification.
topics.reason: Weariness/blunting belongs to the wider root field and can color exhaustive coverage, but it does not become the local lexical sense.

topics.headline: dominant totality pair in the final coda
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final knowledge claim is not limited to human deeds; it universalizes across every entity.
topics.reason: The local totality phrase and the supplied collocation rows support formulaic exhaustive scope.

words.gloss_range: indefinite singular thing as the complement of every
words.root_gloss_range: thinghood, knowable/reportable entity, and possible willing association; locally maximally open entity

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: recurring divine-omniscience formula: knowing of every thing

words.prose: {{ar:شَىْءٍ}} ({{tr:shayʾin}}) keeps the universal scope maximally open. As an indefinite singular under {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}), it makes universality distributive: every entity qualifies one by one. The derivational debate linking thinghood with willing can remain as theological pressure, but the local payoff is that no class of knowable entity falls outside the final knowledge claim. The phrase joins the recurring omniscience formula {{ar:بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ}} ({{tr:bi-kulli shayʾin ʿalīmun}}).

topics.headline: indefinite singular opens the scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that every thing means each entity without class restriction, not a loose plural mass.
topics.reason: QAC marks an indefinite singular genitive noun in construct relation under the universal quantifier.

topics.headline: thinghood with willing pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that every knowable thing may also carry willed-entity pressure, while local grammar keeps the selected sense as thinghood.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute is semantically meaningful but should not replace the local noun sense.

topics.headline: formulaic universal object of knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this phrase is a familiar divine-omniscience formula, making the final claim axiomatic rather than merely local.
topics.reason: The supplied formula rows identify the exact recurring phrase and same-surah universal-object language.

words.gloss_range: indefinite qualitative predicate on the intensive faʿīl pattern: all-knowing
words.root_gloss_range: knowledge, comprehensive knowing, and true-nature cognition; locally inherent divine omniscience
words.prose: {{ar:عَلِيمٌ}} ({{tr:ʿalīmun}}) closes the ayah and the surah with an inherent knowledge attribute. Its indefiniteness gives qualitative force rather than merely naming a title, and the faʿīl pattern presents knowledge as enduring, not situational or acquired. The earlier verb {{ar:يَعْلَمُ}} ({{tr:yaʿlamu}}) becomes a final attribute: God knows what you are upon because God is knowing of every thing. The paired tanwīn cadence binds the universal thing to the final attribute, and the final sound also turns the nearby punishment-resonance from 24:63 into divine cognition while the ownership-return-omniscience ring seals the ayah.

topics.headline: indefinite predicate as quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word presents an enduring quality of knowing, not simply a label.
topics.reason: QAC marks a nominative qualitative adjective functioning as predicate in the final nominal sentence.

topics.headline: faʿīl pattern and unacquired knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final knowledge is inherent and comprehensive, grounding both present knowing and future informing.
topics.reason: The faʿīl pattern and lexical evidence support inherent intensive knowledge.

topics.headline: final word seals Surah 24
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the whole surah's legal, social, and eschatological material lands under this final omniscience attribute.
topics.reason: The word is the final word of Surah 24, making its closure function locally decisive.

topics.headline: knowing verb resolves into knowing attribute
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the root arc from God knows at word 11 to God is all-knowing at the final word.
topics.reason: The same root occurs as a verb earlier and as the final adjective here.

topics.headline: nasal closure and ownership-return-omniscience ring
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final cadence binding thing and knowledge, the contrast with 24:63, and the ayah's ring from possession through return to omniscience.
topics.reason: The sound row, 24:63 boundary row, and QY synthesis all align with the ayah's local frame.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The frame 'to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth' closes with 'Allah is knowing of every thing.'
baseline_models.mechanism: The opposite vertical poles enclose the inhabited domain; the repeated divine name frames that domain, while 'all' and 'thing' remove residual exceptions. Ownership and knowledge therefore coincide in scope.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped-and-worship image identifies the claimant at both ends of the focus and makes belonging answerable rather than merely spatial.
What rises and overshadows supplies the upper pole of the owned domain.
The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the complementary pole, closing the spatial span.
Disclosure to the knower joins present awareness to the final all-encompassing predicate.
The image of encompassing all parts closes every gap in the knowledge claim.
A thing as whatever can be known and reported makes each particular eligible for the closing knowledge claim.

changed_reading.before: A cosmic possession statement followed by a general assertion of omniscience.
changed_reading.after: Every occupant and every reportable particular lies inside one owned and already known domain.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence 'He knows what you are upon' then 'the day they are returned to Him, He informs them of what they did.'
baseline_models.mechanism: Present condition is already disclosed to the knower; a bounded decisive day brings a passive return, after which an arriving report confronts each person with intentional action. The report reveals rather than supplies divine knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge as disclosure to the knower establishes that the current stance is already open before the return.
The image of a momentous occurrence gives the disclosure a decisive temporal horizon.
Return or restoration supplies the movement back to the focus's divine endpoint.
An arriving, consequential report makes the known record confront the returned subjects.
Intentional action fixes the report's object as enacted conduct rather than an unformed inner possibility.

changed_reading.before: People will eventually be reminded of their deeds.
changed_reading.after: An already-known present stance advances to compelled return and personal disclosure of its intentional record.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah opens by making norms visible signs and disclosed meanings, then repeats that pairing. Against that sequence, the final informing reads as the terminal exposure of conduct made distinguishable by those signs.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge as a distinguishing mark supplies the focus-side capacity for conduct to be traced.
A visibly manifest sign supplies public criteria by which conduct becomes distinguishable.
Disclosure of meaning by speech or sign makes those criteria intelligible rather than merely visible.
The consequential report gathers the marked conduct into a final intelligible disclosure.

structural_cues: The sign-and-clarification pairing recurs at 24:18, 24:34, 24:46, 24:58-59, and 24:61 before the closing report.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible signs, clarified meaning, and knowledge as a mark; I infer that norms make later conduct evidentially legible. A live alternative is that the final knowledge remains purely divine cognition, without this pedagogical trace function.

changed_reading.before: The closing report discloses deeds known independently of the surah's instruction.
changed_reading.after: The closing report culminates a process in which clarified signs have made each response distinguishable and answerable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first demands witnessed proof, then follows falsehood as it is inverted and relayed by knowledge-deficient tongues. On the decisive day, the tongue itself becomes an informed witness to action and truth stands fixed. The divine report thus reverses corrupted human reporting through an embodied evidentiary record.

activation_trace.role: The consequential report is the focus anchor whose authority is sharpened by the surah's failed human reports.
Testimony as declaration grounded in knowledge establishes the surah's evidentiary standard.
Falsehood turned away from truth supplies the distortion that the final report must undo.
The speech organ carries the ungrounded report, locating distortion in embodied transmission.
The explicit absence of knowledge diagnoses why the circulating human report fails.
Informed declaration returns as testimony, now generated by the subject's own organs.
The same speech organ is reassigned from rumor-carrier to witness.
Intentional deeds are exactly the object of bodily testimony and of the focus's final report.
Truth fixed in correspondence with reality supplies the settled result of the evidentiary reversal.

structural_cues: 24:15's 'what you have no knowledge of' contrasts with the repeated divine knowledge in 24:64.
24:24 repeats both the decisive day and the formula 'what they used to do' immediately before truth is made manifest in 24:25.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inverted falsehood, tongues transmitting without knowledge, and later bodily testimony; I infer that the final informing restores truth through a self-attesting record. A live alternative is a direct divine declaration with no implied evidentiary process.

changed_reading.before: God tells people what they did.
changed_reading.after: The authoritative final report repairs a world of inverted and ungrounded speech by confronting each person with embodied testimony to the actual deed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Homes create real inside-outside boundaries and entry is permission-gated, yet the manifest and concealed remain equally known to God. The heavens-earth totality therefore reaches into domestic and inward zones without converting divine access into human entitlement.

activation_trace.role: The overarching upper realm supplies one boundary of the total domain within which every smaller enclosure sits.
The lower inhabited realm places domestic interiors inside, not outside, the focus's scope.
Entry into an interior supplies the human crossing that requires regulation.
Shelter and dwelling supply a materially bounded private zone.
Permission makes human access conditional and preserves the enclosure's ethical force.
Divine knowledge explicitly spans both sides of the following concealment contrast.
Emergence into visibility supplies the public side of conduct.
Concealment and covering supply the private or inward side that remains known.
Repeated knowledge closes public, private, current, and eventual conduct into one audit.

structural_cues: 24:27-31 repeatedly regulate entry, gaze, appearance, and concealment rather than treating privacy as unreal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies real human boundaries plus divine knowledge of manifest and concealed conduct; I infer that cosmic ownership contains every enclosure while leaving human permission rules intact. A live alternative is that 24:64 remains cosmic in scale and does not reactivate the domestic sequence.

changed_reading.before: Heavens and earth name an abstract cosmic totality.
changed_reading.after: The totality includes every ethically protected interior and concealed act, even though no human gains license to cross those boundaries.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same heavens-earth span is illuminated and guiding at 24:35, populated by creatures practicing praise and prayer at 24:41, and named as sovereignty moving toward an outcome at 24:42. The close condenses these into an audit of where humans stand within an ordered, worshipping domain.

activation_trace.role: The overarching sky supplies the upper half of the domain repeated across the activating sequence.
The earth supplies the lower half of that same illuminated, active, and governed domain.
Illumination makes the heavens-earth domain a field of disclosure rather than inert property.
Gentle direction toward a path gives the illuminated domain an orienting force.
Praise and worship make the domain actively responsive to its owner.
Specified worship gives each creature an enacted orientation within the cosmic order.
Sovereignty turns the focus's belonging formula into governed dominion.
Becoming toward an outcome anticipates the focus's return to the same owner.
Return realizes the destination already attached to cosmic sovereignty.

structural_cues: 24:35 and 24:64 share the heavens-earth span and the exact all-things knowledge closure.
24:41 and 24:64 share the heavens-earth span, 'all,' divine knowledge, and the acts of the domain's inhabitants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies illumination, guidance, creaturely worship, sovereignty, and destination around repeated focus language; I infer that 'what you are upon' measures alignment within that order. A live alternative is simple formulaic recapitulation without an alignment claim.

changed_reading.before: God owns the cosmos and knows the human condition.
changed_reading.after: Humans are audited for their orientation inside an illuminated, worshipping, governed cosmos already moving toward its owner.

context_deltas.mechanism: Good action is met by corresponding recompense, while mirage-like works end in a fully paid account. The focus's return-report sequence can therefore carry more than information: deeds arrive as a completed reckoning whose outcome answers their character.

activation_trace.role: Return supplies the movement into the settlement scene.
The consequential report makes the account personally intelligible.
Intentional action is the common object of report and recompense.
Meeting an act with its recompense supplies the reciprocal arrow from deed to outcome.
The rewarded object is the same intentional action named in the focus.
Mirage-like works supply the contrasting case in which apparent yield collapses at settlement.
Counting and account turn the deed-outcome relation into a reckoning rather than a bare recollection.
Full completion without deficiency makes the reckoning exact and settled.

structural_cues: 24:38-39 place accepted and mirage-like works in parallel outcome scenes before 24:64 again names what people did.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies corresponding recompense and a fully completed account; I infer that the final informing participates in settlement, not only recollection. A live alternative is that notification and recompense are adjacent but distinct acts.

changed_reading.before: The returned subjects receive information about past deeds.
changed_reading.after: They confront deeds as an exact account whose returned outcome answers what those deeds actually were.

context_deltas.mechanism: Claimed obedience can turn into withdrawal; true believers remain upon a gathering affair until permission, while others slip out by hiding behind one another. The immediately repeated 'He certainly knows' makes 'what you are upon' a positional audit of enacted allegiance, including covert exit.

activation_trace.role: Repeated divine knowledge anchors the focus's audit of the addressees' present position.
Professed obedience supplies one claimed stance toward the summons.
Turning away supplies enacted withdrawal that contradicts the claimed stance.
Affair or present concern supplies the concrete object on which the group is jointly positioned.
Gathering dispersed persons into one whole gives that affair its communal geometry.
The immediately preceding knowledge formula targets those whose movement is designed to escape notice.
Slipping out supplies covert physical disengagement from the shared affair.
Hiding behind another supplies the social technique used to mask that disengagement.
Binding command identifies the authority from which covert withdrawal departs.

structural_cues: 24:62 places believers 'upon a gathering affair,' closely anticipating 24:64's 'what you are upon.'
24:63 and 24:64 repeat 'qad ya'lamu' across the boundary between covert departure and the closing audit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an 'upon' shared affair, permission-governed departure, covert slipping, and repeated knowledge; I infer that the focus audits allegiance through bodily position and movement. A live alternative is that 'what you are upon' remains a general condition with no special communal reference.

changed_reading.after: God knows whether a person is truly situated within the shared command or only claims obedience while turning or slipping away.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates road and marker branches behind ordinary words for knowing, informing, and working. It remains anchored in the focus's 'upon,' return, report, and deeds, while the packet explicitly supplies followed footsteps, an extended way, a straight road, and covert departure. Downstream prose should present it as a spatial-material analogy, not as a lexical replacement or translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The linked focus branches make knowledge a waymark, informing a clear road, work a traversed road, and return a retracing movement.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing waymark makes the traveled course readable.
A clear road gives the final report a route-revealing image.
A road made passable by use lets repeated acts materialize as a traversed track.
Return supplies the backward movement from which the completed track can be surveyed.
Followed footprints supply the incremental formation of a behavioral route.
An extended traversable way supplies the legitimate route against which footsteps can be compared.
The straight road sharpens the route into an orienting norm.
Slipping out supplies the final deviant movement immediately before the route is audited.

changed_reading.before: Deeds form an itemized record that will be verbally reported.
changed_reading.after: Deeds form a walked track: its steps, deviations, and waymarks make the person's actual course visible when the traveler is returned.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads a domestic entry rule as a miniature analogue of ultimate return. It remains anchored through the exact return root in 24:28 and 24:64, with entry, permission, action, and knowledge in the same local sequence. Downstream prose should qualify it as an ethical rehearsal of accepting limits, not identify the two returns or derive eschatology from house etiquette.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The passive ultimate return in 24:64 reactivates the commanded return from a threshold in 24:28.

activation_trace.role: Return to an originating direction anchors the final compelled movement.
Entry into an interior creates the threshold at which willingness is tested.
Permission makes crossing depend on acknowledged authority rather than desire alone.
The doubled command to return supplies a voluntary, present-scale enactment of accepting a limit.
Intentional compliance at the threshold enters the deed record named in the focus.
Divine knowledge immediately audits whether the commanded return was enacted.

changed_reading.before: Ultimate return is detached from the surah's ordinary social movements.
changed_reading.after: Every accepted threshold rehearses a willing return under authority before the day on which return is no longer optional.

strongest_changes: The evidence sequence turns the final informing into an authoritative repair of false, knowledge-deficient human reporting through embodied witness.
The domestic sequence places protected interiors and concealed acts inside divine scope without erasing human permission boundaries.
The light, worship, sovereignty, and destination sequence turns cosmic ownership into an audit of alignment within an active ordered domain.
The immediate 24:62-63 sequence gives 'what you are upon' positional force: remaining with, turning from, or covertly leaving a shared command.
summary.what_was_special: The close recombines formulas distributed across the surah, but the immediate repetition of 'qad ya'lamu' after covert withdrawal most sharply changes the focus. The branch inventories also preserve a live track-reading in which deeds become the route and marks by which a life is disclosed.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not decide whether the final informing itself performs settlement or precedes a distinct recompense.
The alignment reading may be a deliberate recapitulation of 24:35-42 or only a strong thematic echo.
The traversed-track and boundary-rehearsal readings are controlled analogies, not lexical translations.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Return converts concealed conduct into an authoritative consequential report.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed-ayah `ر ج ع` B001 is return/sending back; `ن ب ء` B002 is consequential news producing knowledge and B003 divine informing; `ع م ل` B001 is intentional doing; `ع ل م` B001 is knowledge; `ك ل ل` B003 is totality and completeness; `ش ي ء` B001 is every knowable thing. **Structural cue:** 24:59-62 define mature permission, relational access, and authorized leave; 24:63 exposes people who slip away under cover. The final ayah moves from present divine knowledge to future return and report of what they did. **Assigned role:** return gathers dispersed actors, informing makes deeds explicit to their doers, and total knowledge leaves no hidden remainder. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies covert action, prior knowledge, return, and report; I infer that return does not give God new information but converts privately rationalized acts into inescapable disclosed consequence for the actors. **Reading change:** the close replaces rumor and concealment with a report grounded in complete knowledge and actual deeds.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: No later ayah exists in the packet. The terminal ayah instead retrospectively gathers the preceding permission, concealment, and action sequence into complete knowledge, return, and report.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Distributed human control remains inside encompassing possession and knowledge, so attempted escape ends in return, report, and a destination with no external refuge.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Owned dependents and keys earlier in P4 activate latent sovereignty branches; open-earth flight, failed outrunning, desert ambiguity, shelter, fire, and return turn final accountability into a closed trajectory.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Human ownership and delegated control are nested inside sovereignty that encompasses the upper and lower world and knows every state within it.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tapınma eylemini, kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini, bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı ve tapınılan varlığı aynı anlam örgüsü içinde açıkça birleştirir. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ondan türeyen varlık adlarını doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tapınma eylemi ile bundan türeyen tapınılan veya tapınılır kılınan varlık anlamlarını kapsar; şaşkınlık, yoğun üzüntü ve salt özel ad kullanımları bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eylem çekirdeğini türemiş eylem ve varlık adlarından ayırır; türemiş biçimlerin kapsamı yalın eylemin tamamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, tapınmayı anlamın temeli sayar; kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılma işlemini bu temelden türetir. Tapınma konusu sayılan yontular ve güneş örneği, varlık anlamının belirli uygulamalarıdır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أله وتأله بمعنى عبد وتنسك، والتأليه بمعنى التعبيد، والإله والآلهة والإلاهة لما جعل معبودا.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه أله بمعنى تحير، ولا ألهت على فلان بمعنى اشتد جزعي عليه، ولا أسماء المواضع أو الحية أو الهلال إلا من جهة التسمية لا معنى العبادة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو التعبد، فالإله الله تعالى لأنه معبود، وتأله الرجل إذا تعبد، والإلاهة الشمس سميت بذلك لأن قوما كانوا يعبدونها (maqayis)؛ التأله التعبد (ayn)؛ أله بالفتح إلاهة أي عبد عبادة، مألوه أي معبود، الآلهة الأصنام، التأليه التعبيد، التأله التنسك والتعبد (sihah)؛ لا يكون إلاها حتى يكون معبودا، معبوداتهم من الأصنام والأوثان آلهة، الإلاهة الشمس، وإلاهتك وعبادتك (tahdhib)؛ إله اسما لكل معبود، أله فلان يأله الآلهة عبد، فالإله على هذا هو المعبود (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini, genel tapınılan-varlık adından türetiliş açıklamasını ve bu özel adla kurulan seslenme ile ant biçimlerini birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak dal yalnızca seslenme ve ant kalıpları değildir; özel adın yalın kullanımı da çekirdekte tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, özel ad ile bu ada bağlı seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimleriyle sınırlıdır; herhangi bir tapınılan varlığı gösteren genel ad anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın özel ad, doğrudan seslenme biçimleri ve ant ya da şaşma kalıpları ayrı tutulur; kalıplara özgü işlevler özel adın her kullanımına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini ve bu adla kurulan seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimlerini kapsar. Bu biçimler doğrudan seslenme, adın ant değeriyle kullanılması veya ses ve parçaların düşürülmesiyle kısaltılma yollarını gösterir.

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
Özel adın, tapınılan varlığı bildiren genel addan ses düşmesi ve belirleyici unsur eklenmesiyle oluştuğu açıklanır.
Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.
Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi adı bir şeyi tanıtan gösterge olarak tanımlar; ad verme, ad edinme, adaşlık ve aynı adı ya da niteliği hak eden denklik anlamlarını açıkça bağlar. Adın anılmayı yükselttiğine ilişkin açıklama anlamın tarihsel gerekçesi olarak tutulur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal dilsel adlandırma ve adla kurulan denklikle sınırlıdır; gök ya da fiziksel yükselme anlamı yalnız açıklayıcı köken bağıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ad çekirdeği; ad verme, ad edinme, adaşlık ve ad ya da nitelik bakımından denklik bildiren özel biçimlerden ayrılarak tanımlanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi tanıtan ad, bu adı verme veya edinme ve başka biriyle aynı adı taşıma ilişkisidir. Ayrıca aynı adı ya da niteliği hak edecek ölçüde denk olmayı anlatır; kaynaklar adlandırmayı anılmayı yükseltme düşüncesiyle açıklar.

facets.statement: Ad, bir varlığı tanıtan ve ondan söz etmeyi sağlayan söz veya anlamdır.
Birine ad verilir veya kişi kendisi için bir ad edinir ve o adla çağrılır.
İki kişi aynı adı taşıdığında birbirinin adaşı olur.
Bir kişi, aynı adı veya niteliği hak edecek ölçüde başkasının dengi sayılır.
Kaynaklar adın kökenini, adı verilen şeyin anılmasını yükseltmesi ve onu belirgin kılmasıyla açıklar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar adı bir varlığı tanıtan unsur sayar; ad verme, ad edinme, aynı adı taşıma ve ada ya da niteliğe layık denklik anlamlarını birleştirir. Adın anılmayı yükselttiği yönündeki köken açıklamasını da paylaşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi çekirdeği bir topluluğun ıssız arazilere av için çıkması olarak verir; avcı adı, av hayvanını arama ve avcının sıcak zeminde beklerken giydiği çorap da aynı av alanına bağlıdır. Dal çerçevesi bu bağı korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel gitmeyi değil, av amacıyla açık ve ıssız araziye çıkmayı ve yalnız buna bağlı kişi, arama ve araç kullanımlarını kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Av için araziye çıkma çekirdeği; avcı, av hayvanını arama ve avcı çorabı bildiren özel biçimlerden ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluğun avlanmak için kır ve çöl gibi ıssız arazilere çıkmasıdır. Avcılar, av hayvanını arama ve avcının sıcak zeminde beklerken giydiği koruyucu çorap bu çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir topluluk avlanmak amacıyla kır veya çöl gibi ıssız araziye çıkar.
Bu amaçla araziye çıkan kişiler avcı adıyla anılır.
Av hayvanını bulup avlamak üzere arama eylemi aynı alana bağlıdır.
Avcının sıcak zeminde hayvan beklerken ayağını korumak için giydiği çorap adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar av için kır ve çöl arazisine çıkmayı ortak çekirdek olarak verir; avcı adını, av hayvanını aramayı ve sıcak zeminde bekleyen avcının koruyucu çorabını buna bağlar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi karşılıklı yarışma, övünerek boy ölçüşme ve birbirine karşı koymayı aynı dalda birleştirir; kimsenin yarışamadığı kişi ifadesi de bu karşılaştırma eksenine dayanır. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu yapıyı doğru karşılar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal karşılıklı yarışma ve denk gelme alanındadır; yalnız aynı adı taşıma ya da genel üstünlük bu karşılıklılık olmadan dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Karşılıklı yarışma çekirdeği, övünerek boy ölçüşme, karşı koyma ve kimsenin yarışamaması bildiren özel biçimlerle karıştırılmadan verilir.

concept_map.definition: İki tarafın üstün gelmek için birbiriyle yarışması, övünerek boy ölçüşmesi veya birbirine karşı koymasıdır. Bir kimseyle hiç kimsenin yarışamaması, onun bu karşılaştırmada erişilemez üstünlüğünü bildirir.

facets.statement: İki veya daha çok taraf üstün gelmek için karşılıklı olarak yarışır.
Taraflar sahip oldukları üstünlüklerle övünerek birbirleriyle boy ölçüşür.
Taraflardan biri ötekine karşı koyar, onunla aynı düzeye gelmeye veya onu geçmeye çalışır.
Kimsenin bir kişiyle yarışamaması, o kişinin erişilemez ölçüde üstün olduğunu bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar karşılıklı yarışma, övünerek boy ölçüşme ve karşı koyma anlamlarını birleştirir; bir kişiyle kimsenin yarışamaması ifadesini onun üstünlüğünün sonucu olarak verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi ya da hayvanı tanınmasını sağlayacak görünür bir izle işaretleme eylemini, bu eylemin bıraktığı izi ve işaretlemede kullanılan kızgın aracı birlikte verir. Sağlanan dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, her türlü soyut belirtiyi değil; yakma, kulak kesme veya çentikleme gibi yollarla bırakılan tanıtıcı fiziksel izi kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, ortak fiziksel işaretleme çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır; zırhın alt bölümündeki süslemeyi anlatan özel tamlama yalnızca kendi sözlüksel karşılığında korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi ya da hayvanı, tanınmasını veya ayırt edilmesini sağlayan kalıcı ve görünür bir fiziksel iz oluşturacak biçimde işaretlemektir; iz yakma, kulak kesme ya da çentikleme yoluyla bırakılabilir. Anlam alanı, oluşan işareti ve özellikle hayvanı işaretlemeye yarayan kızgın aracı da kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesne veya hayvan üzerinde onu tanıtmaya ve başkalarından ayırmaya yarayan görünür bir fiziksel iz oluşturulur.
İşaret, kızgın araçla yakılarak, kulağın bir bölümü kesilerek veya çentik açılarak bırakılabilir.
Eylemin sonucunda kalan tanıtıcı iz de aynı anlam alanında adlandırılır.
Özellikle hayvanlara bu izi koymak için kullanılan kızgın işaretleme aracı da bu dala bağlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatımda temel ilişki, tanınacak şey üzerinde kasıtlı ve kalıcı bir iz oluşturma ilişkisidir. Yakma, kulak kesme ve çentikleme bu işlemin yollarıdır; sonuçtaki iz ile onu koyan kızgın araç da anlam alanına dahildir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişide görülen belirtiyi okuyarak iyilik, kötülük veya genel durum hakkında sonuç çıkarma eylemini açıkça anlatır. Dal çerçevesindeki bakma, belirti ve çıkarım ilişkisi bu anlamı doğru korur.

facets.statement: Kişide görülen bir belirti, görünmeyen bir nitelik veya durumun göstergesi olarak okunur.
Gözlemden hareketle sezgisel bir değerlendirme ve çıkarım yapılır.
Çıkarılan nitelik iyilik de kötülük de olabilir; anlam yalnızca olumlu bir yargıyla sınırlı değildir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisinde de görünür bir belirti, doğrudan görünmeyen başka bir şeye ulaşmayı sağlar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal psikolojik bir okuma ve çıkarım eylemidir; komşu dal ise göstergenin bilgi verme işlevini genel olarak adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; olumlu nitelik sezme, izden tanıma ve genel gösterge ilişkileri okurun karıştırabileceği üç ayrı sınırı gösterdiği için seçildi.
